title: Christmas Special 2025
summary: A man is found shot dead in a villa where a group of employees are staying for their company retreat.
method: The killer travelled to Saint Marie overnight just to shoot the victim and used a fake passport to impersonate a former employee. The victim survived and attempted to treat his own wounds. He tried to warn the people at the villa but succumbed to his injuries when he got there. The accomplice helped cover up the crime by applying cologne to mask the smell of antiseptic that the victim used to dress his wound. The accomplice also switched out the bullets to one that was show by a gun when he was in England.
motive: The victim owned a rental property and was on the verge of discovering that the killer was assuming a false identity when booking that property. An employee stole money from the company and attempted to return it when the killer intercepted her and accidentally killed her (and buried her body in her backyard). The killer went to Saint Marie to establish the story that the employee ran off with the money and paid the victim a large sum of money. The killer wanted to keep the money and spend it lavishly because she hasn't seen this sum of money in her life.
notes: Darlene appears on video call only
